title: Registry Playground Dedupe For In-Flight Plugin Migrations
description: Fix plugin-registry script bug: LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT is applied to the constitutional-crate check but not to playground registration, so registry check/generate hard-fails the entire workspace whenever a plugin (currently 🌍️gis) is mid-migration and has both its old bundle crate and new taxonomy crate on disk, both registering the same [package.metadata.semio.playground] entries. Fix: when two crates under the SAME plugin id (one legacy-shape, one new-contract 📦️packages/🦀️rust) produce playground entries with the same variant id, dedupe by preferring the new-contract entry and silently dropping the legacy one. Only error when two DIFFERENT plugin ids collide on a variant id. File: 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/📜️script.ts
summary:
Fixed the plugin-registry hard-failure on in-flight plugin migrations. `LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT` tolerance (dual legacy+new-contract crate on disk during migration) was applied to the constitutional-crate gate but not to playground registration, so `check`/`generate` hard-failed the whole workspace whenever ANY plugin was mid-migration (confirmed live-affected: fem, forms, gis, puzzle, reasoning by the time of verification — not just gis as originally reported, since other migrations landed concurrently).

Fix in `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/📜️script.ts`:
- Extracted the inline new-contract-crate regex test out of `findPluginCargoFiles` into a shared `isNewContractPluginManifestPath(path)` helper (single source of truth, no new regex invented).
- Added `dedupeInFlightPlaygroundEntries` (new `🧹️PlaygroundDedupe` region): groups raw playground entries by variant id; when a group shares one `pluginId` and only some entries come from a new-contract crate (`📦️packages/🦀️rust`), keeps only the new-contract entry/entries and silently drops the legacy duplicate(s). Variant collisions across DIFFERENT plugin ids are left untouched, still caught by `validatePlaygroundRegistry` as a genuine naming collision.
- Wired the dedupe into `generatePlaygroundRegistry` between raw collection and the existing example-donor backfill loop, so both `generate` and `check` (and everything downstream: `buildPlaygroundSession`, `resolveRegistryPluginIdsForFilter`, the generated catalog files) see the deduped list.

Verification (synchronous, via `bun nx run @semio-tech/plugin-registry:check|generate` and direct `bun 📜️script.ts` invocation):
- Before fix: `check` failed with 9 duplicate-variant/alias/port error groups (fem2d, fem3d, forms, gis2d, gis3d, puzzle2d, puzzle3d, puzzle5d, reasoning-wires), each reporting a legacy-shape crate (`🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust`) colliding with the corresponding new-contract crate (`📦️packages/🦀️rust`).
- After fix: `generate` produces 58 playgrounds (down from 67 raw/pre-dedupe — the 9 duplicate groups collapsed to 1 each) and 41 plugin crate entries (unchanged — crate-level `PLUGIN_BUILD_TARGETS` intentionally still lists both crates per in-flight plugin as separate wasm build targets; that's a pre-existing, unrelated, non-blocking shape, out of this ticket's scope). `check` now exits 0 ("plugin registry catalog is fresh (41 plugin crates, 58 playgrounds)"), with only the pre-existing warn-only taxonomy-tree findings printed (not failing the gate, as before).
- Spot-checked `generated/🔣️playgrounds.json`: zero duplicate variant ids remain; gis2d/gis3d each appear exactly once, both under `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌍️gis/📦️packages/🦀️rust`; all already-migrated plugins (writer, vcs, shooting, sequence, animate, cad, sourcing, flow, procedural) present exactly once at their expected crate paths, untouched by the dedupe.
- `cargo metadata --no-deps --offline` exits 0 (sanity check — this was a TS-only change).

Files touched: `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/📜️script.ts` (only file changed; `🤖️generated/*` outputs are gitignored build artifacts, regenerated but not tracked).
